name: _adaptive_avg_pool3d_backward
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_adaptive_avg_pool3d_backward(Tensor grad_output, Tensor self) -> Tensor. Computes the input gradient for three-dimensional adaptive average pooling. Coverage includes batched channel layouts, downsampling, equal-size pooling and strong upsampling where one input position receives contributions from more than two output positions per spatial dimension. The result has self's shape and dtype; neither input is mutated or aliased.
